entry.title: Kubernetes Removals and Major Changes In v1.31
entry.summary: As Kubernetes develops and matures, features may be deprecated, removed, or replaced with better ones for the project's overall health. This article outlines some planned changes for the Kubernetes v1.31 release that the release team feels you should be aware of for the continued maintenance of your Kubernetes environment. The information listed below is based on the current status of the v1.31 release. It may change before the actual release date. The Kubernetes API removal and deprecation process The Kubernetes project has a well-documented deprecation policy for features.
